kjv: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.
note: TR's 7:16 is a scribal refrain (from 4:9, 4:23); absent from Sinaiticus, Vaticanus, Codex Regius and others.

kjv: and goeth out into the draught, purging all meats?
mine: and is expelled? (Thus he declared all foods clean.)
note: katharizon panta ta bromata (masculine participle in the best manuscripts) agrees with the subject of "he says" in 7:18, i.e. Jesus' declaration that all foods are clean; KJV (with TR's neuter katharizon) attaches it to the digestive process, losing Mark's comment on the food laws.

kjv: as the washing of pots and cups: and many other such like things ye do
note: TR adds "baptismous xeston kai poterion ..." from 7:4 and 7:13.
